confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Boston price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain. Cocktail and wine are estimated from typical US metro bar pricing rather than local data. Hotel and hostel anchors are the least certain because July rates swing widely with events and demand. FX value taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general US Northeast large-metro price levels, benchmarked against typical Boston-area ordinary restaurant, pub, and summer lodging prices.
